jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Nuwave, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions in the wireless telecom industry. With a focus on innovation, safety, and excellence, we partner with leading providers to build and maintain the networks that keep our world connected. Whether it’s streamlining site acquisition or executing complex construction projects, our talented team is at the forefront of the industry. This role is a full-time, in-office position based out of our Signal Hill, CA headquarters.

We're expanding our Southern California PMO and seeking experienced Project Coordinators at the I, II, and III levels to support our Project Management team on wireless deployments across LA, Orange County, Inland Empire, and San Diego areas. Your level will be determined by your experience, demonstrated ownership of coordination details, and track record supporting project execution.

If you're ready to advance your career with a company that values teamwork, integrity, and your professional development, we want to hear from you! Please complete the online application included in this job posting. If you have any questions, feel free to email us at employment@nuwavecom.com

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking experienced Project Coordinators to support Project Managers and Construction Managers in the day-to-day implementation of wireless telecommunications construction projects, including maintaining project trackers, folders, and documentation; scheduling; coordinating permitting; and supporting the closeout packages (COP). The Project Coordinator ensures policies and procedures for project management are consistently followed and executed, and serves as a key operational partner to the PM, CM, warehouse, subcontractors, and clients. This position reports to the Market Manager and receives project-level work direction from the Project Manager.

**Key Responsibilities (All Levels):**

* Represents Nuwave with the highest degree of professionalism in all situations
* Assists the Project Manager with day-to-day project coordination duties

* Maintains and updates the daily work schedule
* Schedules site access with landlords
* Schedules BOM pickup
* Schedules equipment call-off and pickup
* Works with warehouse personnel to inventory and track materials and customer assets
* Schedules pre-construction walks with customers, landlords, municipalities, utilities, internal personnel, and other applicable entities
* Submits requests to pull permits and schedules final inspections for jurisdictional permits
* Schedules public and private utility locators
* Supports project COP deliverables and packages with internal and external resources
* Reviews all COP deliverables for accuracy
* Processes all COP deliverables
* Reviews all photos against the photo checklist and naming convention
* Verifies project-related test results (sweep test, PIM test, fiber test, ground test, etc.)
* Verifies job-related forms (antenna inventory, RET screenshots, asset tracking, etc.)

* Uploads deliverables to the customer interface

* Directs quality assurance corrections to subcontractors and internal resources under the direction of the Project Manager

* Captures and communicates relevant management information for analysis by the Project Manager and leadership

**Additional Responsibilities – Project Coordinator III:**

* Provides senior-level coordination support to the Project Manager across a complex or high-volume project portfolio

* Assigns tasks to the project team and works proactively to remove blockers before they impact delivery
* Coordinates project finances across assigned portfolios in support of the Project Manager

jobs.title: Lead Coach and Program Coordinator - Tennis
jobs.description:
About us

Based in Westchester, Hot Shots Tennis runs afterschool and in-school tennis programs at elementary campuses in Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Venice, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach. Some of our school partnerships go back more than nine years. Our USTA Net Generation-aligned curriculum includes Little Aces (K–2), Future Champs (grades 3–5), and our Level Up skill badge program.

The role

The Lead Coach & Program Coordinator leads classes at our school sites and spends about 6 hours a week on program coordination. The coordination time has flexible hours, can mostly be done remotely, and can be done in the mornings, before classes start at noon. You'll report to the Program Director.

Coaching responsibilities

* Lead afterschool and in-school classes at assigned school sites
* Deliver the Little Aces and Future Champs 10-week curriculum as written
* Run the Level Up badge program: assess skills, track progress, and award levels
* Keep sessions safe, organized, and fun, with a focus on beginners
* Follow each campus's check-in, dismissal, and pickup procedures
* Set up and pack up equipment at every session

Principal relationships and campus reservations stay with the Program Director. Log your coordination hours weekly.

What this role does not handle:

All financial matters are handled by the program's owners. This role has no access to or responsibility for:

* Tuition, payments, refunds, or invoicing
* Pricing, discounts, or contract terms with schools
* Payroll, timesheets beyond your own, or coach pay
* Budgets or purchasing (equipment requests go to the Program Director)
* Scholarships or financial aid

When a parent, school, or coach asks about any of these, reply: "I'll pass that along to our program office, and they'll follow up with you." Then forward the question the same day.

Qualifications

* Experience coaching youth tennis, ideally with elementary-age beginners
* Familiarity with USTA Net Generation (or willingness to get certified)
* Clear, friendly, and reliable written communication with parents and school staff
* Organized and comfortable with email, shared docs, and spreadsheets
* Reliable transportation between Westside and South Bay school sites
* Ability to transport gear for the classes in your vehicle if needed
* Able to pass a background check and meet school-site clearance requirements

Schedule, pay & how to apply

* **Schedule:** 15–17 coaching hours/week, scheduled between 12–4 pm on weekdays and 9–11:30 am on Saturdays, plus about 6 flexible coordination hours/week (about 21–23 hours/week total)
* **Pay:** $40–65/hr on court, depending on experience; $25/hr for coordination work; $80/hr for private lessons
* **Start date:** Mid-November 2026
* **To apply:** send a resume and a short note about your coaching experience to hotshotstennisorg1@gmail.com

Pay: $35.00 - $65.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Young & Healthy**

Through prevention, education, family support, and access to healthcare services, Young & Healthy protects and improves the physical and mental health of uninsured and underinsured children and their families in the greater Pasadena area. The problem with healthcare services in the Pasadena area is not one of availability, but of affordability and accessibility. One of the greatest obstacles to good health is poverty. In the Pasadena community, about one-third of the children are in need of the kind of care Young & Healthy provides. The majority of children under age 18 and enrolled in Pasadena Unified Schools live in areas of town that claim the lowest per capita income and the greatest concentration of poverty.

Young & Healthy’s model is simple: people helping people. Through collaboration with other community institutions, Young & Healthy makes it a point to know the community and be known by the community so that knowledge and resources can be maximized among community partners to assist the greatest number of neighbors in need.

Young & Healthy is now sustained by the generosity of a volunteer workforce of more than 350 healthcare professionals, over 125 community volunteers and an extensive network of community partners to provide free healthcare to needy underserved children. These professional volunteers agree to see children in their own private offices, on a rotating basis, at no charge to the patient or to Young & Healthy. Young & Healthy facilitates the delivery of donated medical, dental, mental health and other healthcare services, free-of-charge, to underserved low-income children, ranging in age from infancy to 18 years, throughout the greater Pasadena area. In addition to healthcare support, Young & Healthy offers these additional services to the community:

**Health Insurance Assistance** – Young & Healthy helps to prepare families to enroll in and navigate the healthcare system by assisting with health insurance enrollment, providing education and instruction, as well as advocating for clients when they have been wrongfully denied.

**Trauma Informed Care** - Young & Healthy is committed to creating a healthy community for children and families by educating children, parents, and educators on how to become more aware of and sensitive to those who have suffered trauma. Through parent education and professional development for teachers, Young & Healthy staff offers a series of trainings on trauma informed care to the public, Pasadena Unified School District staff and administrators, and others.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator is responsible for the insurance enrollment, navigation, and insurance support services of clients referred to Young & Healthy.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**1. Insurance Services**

a. Provide clients with health insurance information, application, and navigation.

b. Assist clients with accessing, understanding, and utilizing health insurance.

c. Continuously update their knowledge base about community services and discover ways for Young & Healthy and our clients to use those services.

d. Identify and communicate to the Program Director newly identified client needs, gaps in services, successes, and issues with case management.

e. Attend and fully participate in the Care Team and all other office meetings for which their attendance is required.

Participate in community networking activities.

**2. Professional Development**

a. Constantly increases knowledge as it relates to the services Young & Healthy provides to the community

**Qualifications:** The qualifications described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**1.**  **Education/Experience**

a. B.A. or B.S. preferred

b. A minimum of 3 years of employment or volunteer activities with a non-profit agency

**2. Special knowledge, skills, and abilities**

a. Must be bilingual in English and Spanish

b. Ability to fluently read, write, and speak English

c. Ability to be flexible, meet deadlines and work effectively under stress

d. Demonstrated leadership skills

e. Ability to work with diverse populations

f. Strong written and oral communication skills

g. Must be detail oriented

h. Strong and positive interpersonal skills, ability to resolve conflicts

i. Ability to organize work, prioritize multiple tasks, and follow through on own initiative

j. Good organizational skills

k. Experience in non-profit organizations

l. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

m. Experience with FAMCare software or other client-based software

**3. Physical Requirements**

a. Must be able to speak and hear

b. Must be able to lift 20 pounds

c. Must have sufficient stamina to work long hours, sit or stand for long periods, and concentrate for long periods of time

d. Evening and weekend work may be required

**Overview**

Somos Group brings together legal and consulting professionals to help public- and private-sector clients solve complex challenges involving cities, development, and communities. We are a minority- and woman-owned business with deep community connections that believes the built environment is a tool for healing and promoting human potential. With offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Mexico City, we work across disciplines to support community resilience, economic development, and social equity.

**About the Position**

Somos Group is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Accounts Payable/Receivable & Administrative Coordinator to join our Administration and Operations team.

This position supports day-to-day financial operations, maintains accurate records, and helps keep payments, approvals, and administrative processes moving. You will communicate regularly with clients, vendors, and colleagues while supporting the Director of Administration and Operations across bookkeeping, compliance, payroll, and benefits administration.

The ideal candidate follows through consistently, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of recurring responsibilities. You should be comfortable working with numbers, tracking outstanding items, and asking questions when something does not look right.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our downtown Los Angeles office and requires some on-site attendance.

* Monitor outstanding balances and conduct regular, professional follow-up by phone and email.
* Maintain clear records of outreach, payments, payment commitments, and next steps.

* Work with the Billing team to resolve invoice questions and payment discrepancies.
* Process incoming checks received in the Los Angeles office.
* Identify overdue accounts that require additional attention and escalate them per established procedures.

**Accounts Payable**

* Monitor accounts payable and bookkeeping inboxes daily.
* Monitor bank accounts daily.

* Maintain accurate records and organized electronic files.
* Help maintain administrative systems, track deadlines, and follow up on open items.

Teamwork and cross-training are central to how our department operates. Everyone learns to back up other team members so essential work continues during absences and busy periods. This shared knowledge strengthens accuracy, continuity, and operational security by ensuring that critical processes do not depend on one person.

* Train to provide backup support for the Billing department, including invoice preparation, edits, approval tracking, and distribution, following established procedures.
* Provide backup coverage for designated administrative and Los Angeles office responsibilities, with appropriate training, access, and direction.
* Participate in cross-training, maintain clear process documentation, and share knowledge so teammates can provide reliable coverage for one another.
* Coordinate priorities and communicate the status of open items to support smooth handoffs and consistent service.

**What You Bring**

* Hands-on experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping support, or a closely related administrative role.
* Understanding of basic bookkeeping principles, invoice processing, payment tracking, and account coding.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review your work for accuracy.
* Consistent follow-through and the ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
* Professional written and verbal communication, including confidence following up with clients and vendors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
* Ability to handle confidential financial, employee, and client information with discretion.
* Comfortable learning new systems, following established procedures, and identifying issues that need attention.
* Ability to work independently while staying responsive and connected to a team.

jobs.description:
**Client Care Coordinator - New Client Sales & Client Relations**

**Comfort Keepers – Huntington Beach, CA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Pay:** Competitive compensation based on experience

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with rotating weeknight and weekend on-call responsibilities

**Location:** Huntington Beach, CA

**Make a Difference Every Day with Comfort Keepers!**

Are you a compassionate, organized, and outgoing professional who loves helping people? Do you enjoy building meaningful relationships, solving problems, and making a positive impact in your community?

**Comfort Keepers of Huntington Beach is looking for a Client Care Coordinator to join our team!**

In this rewarding position, you'll help seniors and their families navigate important care decisions, coordinate personalized home care services, and ensure every client receives the attention and support they deserve.

You'll be an important part of our clients' journeys—from their very first phone call to ongoing care and lasting relationships.

**If you're a people person who enjoys variety, takes initiative, and thrives in a relationship-focused environment, we'd love to meet you!**

**What You'll Do**

**Help Families Get Started with Care**

* Respond to inquiries from prospective clients and families.
* Conduct in-home care consultations to understand each client's needs and preferences.
* Explain Comfort Keepers services, care options, and pricing.
* Help families feel confident in their decisions and guide them through the process of starting care.
* Follow up with prospective clients and help turn inquiries into new client relationships.

**Create Personalized Care Experiences**

* Develop and update individualized non-medical care plans.
* Coordinate new client introductions and support smooth transitions into care.
* Work closely with caregivers and office staff to ensure client needs are understood and met.
* Conduct in-home quality assurance visits and client satisfaction check-ins.
* Identify opportunities to improve the quality of care and overall client experience.

**Build Strong Client & Family Relationships**

* Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients and their families.
* Respond to questions, concerns, and changing care needs with empathy and professionalism.
* Help resolve service-related issues and maintain positive client relationships.
* Build trust and connections that encourage long-term client satisfaction and referrals.

**Support Community Relationships**

* Help maintain relationships with local healthcare providers, senior living communities, and other referral partners.
* Occasionally participate in community networking activities and referral partner visits.
* Represent Comfort Keepers with professionalism, warmth, and enthusiasm.

*Community outreach is a smaller part of this position. The primary focus is client care coordination, consultations, and relationship management.*

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* A friendly, compassionate, and professional personality.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Confidence speaking with families and explaining services.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and solve problems independently.
* Comfortable visiting seniors and families in their homes.
* Basic computer proficiency and willingness to learn home care software.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for local visits.
* Availability for rotating weeknight and weekend on-call responsibilities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–2 years of experience in home care, senior care, healthcare administration, client services, or a related field.
* Experience working with seniors and their families.
* Familiarity with care plans, activities of daily living, or dementia care.
* Experience conducting client consultations or assessments.
* Experience with home care management software.

**You'll Be a Great Fit If You...**

* Genuinely enjoy helping people and building relationships.
* Are warm, approachable, and an excellent listener.
* Can confidently guide families through care decisions.
* Are comfortable explaining the value of services and asking prospective clients to move forward.
* Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved.
* Stay organized while juggling multiple responsibilities.
* Enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
* Believe seniors deserve to live with independence, dignity, and joy.

**Why Work with Comfort Keepers?**

At Comfort Keepers, we believe caregiving is about more than helping with daily tasks. It's about creating meaningful moments, building connections, and helping seniors continue doing the things they love.

Our mission is **Elevating the Human Spirit**, and that commitment extends to our clients, their families, and our team members.

When you join Comfort Keepers, you'll enjoy:

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* A supportive, collaborative team environment.
* A meaningful career helping seniors and families.
* A variety of responsibilities that keep each day interesting.
* Opportunities to grow your skills in client care and home care operations.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you're compassionate, motivated, and excited about helping seniors live happier, more independent lives, we want to hear from you!

**Apply today to join Comfort Keepers of Huntington Beach and help us Elevate the Human Spirit—one client, one family, and one meaningful connection at a time.**

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Retail Production Coordinator is responsible for order processing, which involves entering orders into the company's ERP system, procuring the necessary components to fulfill retail orders, collaborating with the AP team, and working with the Retail sales team to ensure prompt and efficient order fulfillment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

In a fast-paced and growing environment like ours, priorities and projects often change so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

**Order Processing & Procurement**

* Enter purchase orders (POs) and sales orders (SOs) into Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and coordinate purchase order (PO) submission with vendors.
* Maintain and update the Production WIP/tracker with all essential information related to retail purchase orders, and other relevant initiatives.
* Ensure timely and accurate purchase, logging, tracking, and confirmation of order components at the factory level (e.g., hang tags, size strips, price tags).

**Pre-Production & Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Pre-Production Coordinator to confirm accurate factory costs, components, and allocations before order processing.
* Work closely with the Production Manager and Logistics Specialist to oversee the timely delivery of production orders to customers by managing pickups and deliveries domestically and internationally.
* Prepare shipping documentation, including carton labels and packing lists, and coordinate delivery appointments with third-party logistics providers when needed.

**Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Support month-end accounting procedures, including PO receipt processing in the Microsoft Dynamics Business Central clearing maintenance repair and operations (MRO) entries, and transferring blanks scraps to designated locations.
* Work with the Accounting Department to facilitate financial transactions, including delivery notes, credit memos, and vendor payments.

**Process Optimization & Reporting**

* Develop and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency in order processing.
* Ensure accurate documentation and timely submission of shipping records for the Retail Sales team, aiding in invoicing and order fulfillment.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or equivalent work experience
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience in data entry, purchasing, or supply chain coordination. Must have high level accuracy in data entry.
* **Team Player:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills, fostering effective collaboration across teams. A keen ability to take direction and a commitment to accuracy will help you excel in this role.
* **Critical Problem Solver:** Excellent analytical problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and Microsoft Dynamics/ Business Central (preferred).
* **Time Management:** Proven ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with a varied workload.

* Ability to sit, stand, and move around the office environment for extended periods.
* Ability to use a computer keyboard and mouse up to 80% of the workday.
* Ability to reach with hands and arms to access files, equipment, and workstations.

* Ability to clearly distinguish between subtle color variations and nuanced design elements
* Ability to view and assess visual materials on digital screens and printed materials
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds (for sample management and occasional inventory handling)

**Location****:** Long Beach, CA (full-time; onsite)

*This posting is an evergreen position, and we are always on the lookout for talented people to join our team. As our organization grows, we encourage candidates who are passionate about delivering high-quality patient care to express their interest. Founded in 2015, the Food Allergy Institute (FAI) is a cutting-edge research and clinical care center revolutionizing food allergy treatment among the pediatric population. Our Tolerance Induction Program™ is the first of its kind, bringing patients to the point where they can eat whatever they want, whenever they want, without having to worry about any kind of reaction. The success of FAI is built on years of development involving proprietary biomarkers, data analytics and modeling systems which allow unique patient specific therapy to be deployed in the clinic setting and at home safely.

jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Critical Loop**

Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. With deep expertise in grid modernization and a passion for creating resilient, responsive energy solutions, Critical Loop drives innovation at the intersection of technology and energy.

**The Role**

We are hiring an Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support the deployment and day-to-day operation of our mobile battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

This role will own much of the coordination required to move equipment to and from customer sites, manage rental and transportation vendors, maintain accurate site and asset records, support receiving and warehouse activities, and keep operational and maintenance documentation organized.

This is a hands-on, onsite role that combines logistics coordination, operational administration, and practical field support. You will work closely with our Operations Engineers, Projects, Sales, Accounting, and external vendors to make sure equipment, records, and services are where they need to be when they need to be there.

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, follows through reliably, and is comfortable handling both administrative work and practical onsite tasks.

**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate transportation, delivery, retrieval, and staging of batteries, generators, trailers, and other equipment for customer deployments
* Coordinate with rental companies, trucking providers, fuel vendors, and other service providers
* Track equipment rentals, delivery schedules, vendor commitments, and open logistics items
* Support review and reconciliation of rental invoices, fuel deliveries, and other operational costs
* Maintain accurate site, asset, vendor, rental, and operational records in systems such as Salesforce, Odoo, and other internal tools
* Keep maintenance records, service history, and equipment documentation organized and up to date
* Receive packages, freight, and equipment deliveries at our Long Beach facility
* Support warehouse and material-handling activities, including forklift operation once certified
* Assist with equipment registrations, DMV visits, permits, documentation, and other operational administrative tasks as needed
* Track open issues and follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders until they are resolved
* Support site mobilizations and demobilizations by confirming equipment, transportation, vendor, and delivery requirements
* Help identify discrepancies in records, invoices, deliveries, serial numbers, schedules, or other operational information
* Support Operations Engineers and project teams with ad hoc logistics and administrative needs
* Occasionally travel locally to vendors, customer sites, DMV offices, or other locations as required

**Must-Haves**

* Experience coordinating construction logistics, equipment rentals, fleet, field service, or similar physical operations
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent tasks, vendors, and deadlines
* Comfortable working onsite and performing hands-on tasks including receiving freight, warehouse support, material handling, and local errands
* Clear written and verbal communication with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Basic spreadsheet and data competency, including comfort reviewing invoices, fuel deliveries, rental charges, and operational records

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Familiarity with BESS, generators, electrical equipment, or other industrial power systems
* Experience with Salesforce, Odoo, ERP, CMMS, inventory, fleet-management, or similar systems
* Experience reviewing vendor invoices, purchase orders, fuel records, or other operational expenses
* Experience maintaining fleet, equipment, or maintenance records
* Forklift certification or prior material-handling experience; willingness to obtain certification is sufficient
* Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling operations environment

**Work Authorization:** Critical Loop does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e H-1B / OPT training plans etc.).

*At Critical Loop, we're committed to rewarding and supporting our team. Our benefits package includes equity ownership through stock options, giving you a stake in our success, along with comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision) through an HRA with a generous allowance. We also provide a retirement savings plan and unlimited paid time off so you can recharge and maintain work-life balance.*

*Critical Loop is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
The Operations Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining the speed, accuracy, and reliability of day-to-day terminal operations. This position exists to ensure freight flows without disruption, operational data remains accurate in real time, and cross-functional teams are aligned on execution.  
  
In a fast-moving logistics environment, even small delays or communication gaps can create downstream inefficiencies. This role directly mitigates those risks by owning load visibility, coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational systems reflect ground truth.  
  
Success in this role means shipments move predictably, exceptions are identified and escalated early, and the service center operates with precision, accountability, and minimal rework.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**1. Drive operational coordination and load visibility**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Track outbound loads daily and ensure system updates are accurate and timely
* Proactively communicate delays to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders before 11 AM
* Monitor pickup schedules and investigate loads that have not departed by 10 AM
* Escalate operational risks and delays to Linehaul and leadership with clear context

**2. Execute administrative and documentation workflows**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Manage driver documentation, including IC paperwork, plates, IFTA, and compliance materials
* Collect and route maintenance records to Safety to ensure compliance standards are met
* Manifest inbound and outbound freight, ensuring documentation accuracy across systems
* File and maintain exception reports and operational records

**3. Support delivery execution and customer commitments**

**STRIING** · Los Angeles · Part-time, up to 20 hours/week · Hybrid

You will own STRIING's social media and content from day one. This is a hands-on role: you plan the calendar, shoot and edit the content, write the captions, engage the community, and report on what works. You report directly to the founder.

This is a rare chance to build a brand's social presence from the ground up. Once performance is proven, the role can expand to other Suite Creative Studio portfolio brands.

Part-time, up to 20 hours per week to start.

Generous STRIING product allowance.

Send your resume, portfolio, and links to at least 2 accounts you have managed to hotline@mystriing.com

**Position Summary:**  
The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (Lead CRC), **located at our site in Huntington Beach, CA**, is responsible for managing and coordinating the day-to-day operations of clinical research studies, while also providing site-level leadership, mentorship, and oversight to the coordinator team. Reporting to the Site Manager, the Lead CRC ensures protocol compliance, data integrity, and inspection readiness, and serves as the primary resource and first point of escalation for the coordinator group.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage clinical research protocols from start-up to close-out.
* Recruit, screen, consent, and enroll eligible participants in compliance with study protocols and ethical guidelines.
* Collect, record, and maintain accurate data and source documentation for each study subject.
* Schedule and conduct study visits and procedures per protocol and ICH-GCP standards.
* Prepare and submit IRB submissions, amendments, continuing reviews, and adverse event reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry into electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors, CROs, monitors, and regulatory bodies.
* Maintain and organize regulatory binders and study documentation in compliance with FDA and GCP requirements.
* Monitor study inventory and order supplies as needed.
* Support audit readiness and participate in monitoring visits, audits, and inspections.
* Educate and communicate with study participants regarding study procedures, risks, and responsibilities.
* Attend study training, site initiation visits (SIVs), and investigator meetings as needed.

**Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary site-level resource and mentor for clinical research coordinators, including onboarding and ongoing training of new staff.
* Oversee distribution of study assignments and monitor team workload, visit coverage, and protocol timelines across coordinators.
* Conduct quality review of case report forms and source documentation completed by other coordinators to support data integrity and inspection readiness.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for protocol questions, monitor findings, and routine sponsor and IRB communications, escalating to the Site Manager as needed.
* Support the Site Manager with operational coordination, scheduling, and site readiness, and provide coverage in the Site Manager's absence where appropriate.
* Maintain site-level training documentation and support team-wide GCP and regulatory compliance.

**Qualifications:**  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in health sciences, life sciences, nursing, or related field required.
* Certification as a Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) or equivalent preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in clinical research, preferably in a coordinator role, with demonstrated progression in scope and responsibility.
* Experience with IRB processes, electronic data capture (e.g., REDCap, Medidata), and GCP compliance.
* Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or leading coordinator-level staff strongly preferred.

**Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Familiarity with HIPAA and human subject protection regulations.

**Working Conditions:**

* May involve direct patient interaction, phlebotomy, specimen processing, and travel between sites.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to stand, walk, sit, use hands, and reach with arms.

**Pay**:

$85-95k, dependent on experience

**Position:** Inside Sales Representative

**Employment Type:** Regular Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday, 9 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.

**Department:** Marketing & Communications

**Salary Range:**  $22.00/hour, plus tiered, uncapped commission

**About the Role:**

Pacific Symphony is seeking a driven, high-energy Inside Sales Representative to introduce and reintroduce audiences to the world of classical music while generating new institutional revenue. The representative will serve as a primary point of contact for prospective and returning patrons, proactively converting qualified leads into first-time buyers, repeat buyers, Symphony Pass members, and subscribers.

The representative will manage assigned prospects throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial outreach and conversion through follow-up, reengagement, and ongoing cultivation. By developing patron relationships and recommending relevant concerts and ticket products, the representative will help increase repeat attendance, customer lifetime value, and long-term engagement with Pacific Symphony.

This fast-paced, results-oriented role is ideal for individuals who thrive on high-volume outbound outreach, use conversational storytelling to build trust, and love the challenge of closing sales while representing one of Southern California's leading cultural institutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Conversion:** Conduct high-volume outreach to qualified prospects, converting cold and warm leads into first-time ticket buyers, repeat buyers, Symphony Pass members, and package subscribers.
* **Sales Lifecycle Management:** Manage assigned prospects from initial outreach through conversion, post-purchase follow-up, reengagement, cross-selling, and upgrading. Cultivate buyers toward repeat attendance, multi-ticket purchases, Symphony Pass, and subscription products.
* **Patron Engagement:** Serve as a brand ambassador for Pacific Symphony, using consultative and conversational selling to understand patron interests, recommend relevant concert experiences, address questions, and communicate the value of classical music.
* **Revenue Generation**: Meet and exceed individual sales and revenue targets while developing sustainable pipelines of new and returning patrons.

· **Resilience**: Goal-oriented, persistent, and able to navigate customer rejection or challenging outbound conversations.

· **Technical Literacy**: Comfortable using standard computer software, CRM platforms, and sales databases.

· **Self-Starter and Team Collaboration**: Highly motivated to meet individual sales goals with minimal supervision while contributing to a collaborative, supportive team environment.

· **Bonus Qualifications**: Familiarity with or enthusiasm for the performing arts, live events, symphonic music, or nonprofit cultural programming.

The role will work from assigned lead lists and campaigns and will not compete with Box Office or existing Telemarketing responsibilities.

· **Full-Time Benefits Package:** Eligible for Pacific Symphony’s comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid holidays, and vacation time.

Volunteers assistance and undertakes additional tasks to support others. Acknowledges colleagues accomplishments and shares credit on collaborative work.

jobs.title: Day Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**In-Custody Day Program Coordinator**

The Gemma Project is seeking skilled, passionate, and dedicated individuals eager to contribute to our mission of providingand promoting the national creation of gender-responsive jail reentry programming for incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women. The Gemma Project is a trauma responsive, female-led organization that centers integrity and compassion in all the services we provide. Join our team to help us to reduce recidivism, break the intergenerational cycle of incarceration, and create healthier communities.

​​Individuals with a history of justice system involvement are strongly encouraged to apply*.*

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires approximately 50% of work hours within in-custody jail settings and access to sensitive and protected data and therefore requires but is not limited to completion of Live Scan fingerprinting, and Tuberculosis testing prior to hire and ability *to* abide by all in-custody rules as it relates to attire, personal belongings, materials, conduct, and use of sensitive data.

**How you'll fit in:**

You’ll be a great fit for our team if you are highly skilled, compassionate, and dedicated to providing direct-service reentry programming in an in-custody setting to justice involved women. The Day Program Coordinator works to build rapport and trusting relationships with participants in a group setting prior to release and collaborates with the Continuing Care Coordinator through intentional efforts to maintain participant engagement upon release. The Day Program Coordinator conducts all aspects of running in-custody programming including: interviews, assessments, acceptance decisions; develops, delivers and maintains a relevant, applicable and trauma-responsive curriculum; provides consistent course supervision, safety, and structure to support participants in successful program completion, demonstrates healthy professional boundaries; recruits, trains, and supervises volunteer instructors and works with them to improve and update curricula as needed; works in close collaboration with The Gemma Project Team; supervises and provides direction to the Day Program Assistant; conducts necessary outreach for program; assists in evaluation of program effectiveness; maintains program data and contributes to necessary reports; engages professionally with corrections and community partners as well as funders, donors, and model site visitors.

This position reports to the Executive Director.

**What you'll do:**

* Provide overall operations of Gemma Day Program
* Maintain and update the program curriculum and schedule
* Facilitate core components of curriculum
* Recruit, train and maintain skilled volunteer program instructors
* Support, train, and guide volunteer instructors throughout sessions
* Evaluate instructor performance and make programmatic changes when necessary
* Interview, assess and make admission decisions for all applicants
* Evaluate participant progress and provide feedback to participants as needed
* Provide support and redirection to participants as needed in and out of sessions
* Respond to and document program and participant issues in a clear and timely manner
* Supervise Day Program Assistant(s)
* Coordinate with Continuing Care Coordinator on curriculum and reentry planning to assure seamless support for participants transitioning out of custody
* Collect data to assess program effectiveness and work with Executive Director to make necessary changes based on data
* Maintain accurate and timely records and prepare and submit reports as needed
* Plan and facilitate graduation ceremonies
* Perform outreach/recruitment to encourage program participation
* Perform administrative and clerical duties necessary to the position
* Maintain facility, equipment, and materials
* Attend and actively contribute to team meetings and other organizational meetings
* Attend meetings relevant to community partnerships as needed
* Work in close collaboration with Corrections staff to maintain safety, structure and integrity of program
* Regularly communicate and coordinate with Executive Director and report any concerns
* Support related fund development activities
* Provide health and Medi-Cal outreach, information, referral, eligibility, access assistance, planning and MAA coordination activities
* Perform outreach activities related to Program as needed
* Other duties as assigned

**What you'll bring:**

* Passion for The Gemma Project’s mission and empathy for the unique challenges facing incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women
* Commitment to positively contributing to a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and trauma responsive organizational culture through self-awareness, cultural humility, and valuing others
* Dedication to supporting and celebrating female identified individuals in their healing, development, and contributions to the community
* A reputation for a high standard of honesty, integrity, and professionalism
* A curious, detail-oriented, and problem-solving mindset focused on centering gender and trauma responsive services
* The ability to create and maintain collaborative relationships across other functional areas to solve problems, and improve programs, systems, and outcomes for participants
* Receptivity to feedback and ability to ask for and accept help
* The ability to find joy in our work, contribute to optimism, and celebrate individual and team achievements
* Exceptional skill at creating and maintaining a safe, structured, supportive, and trauma-responsive learning environment for participants
* Strong group facilitation and management skills including the ability to maximize participation and engage individuals with different learning styles and abilities
* Strong oral communication skills, including the ability to diffuse and deescalate challenging situations, distill and present complex information in a concise, accessible way, and capability of delivering difficult info

**Job title:** Client Services Coordinator

**Location:** San Francisco, CA; 5 days in office/week

**Status:** Full time; non-exempt (40 hours/week FT NE)

**Salary:** $62,000 - $67,000/year

**Reports to:** Program Director

**Organization Description**

The Miss Major Alexander L. Lee TGIJP Black Trans Cultural Center is a team of transgender, gender-variant and intersex people, inside and outside of prisons, jails, detention centers, and other locked facilities creating a united family in the struggle for survival and freedom. We work in collaboration with others to forge a culture of resistance and resilience to strengthen us for the fight against human rights abuses, imprisonment, police violence, racism, poverty, and societal pressures. We seek to create a world rooted in self-determination, freedom of expression, and gender justice.

**Position Description**

TGIJP’s Client Services Coordinators are the first to greet our clients, staff, partners, Board Members, and other community members when they come into our office. First impressions are everything when it comes to telegraphing safety, security, empowerment, trauma-informed care, and an abolitionist mindset to all we meet. You’re expected to know how to work with dozens of different kinds of people effectively, to know how to appropriately prioritize and execute administrative and operational tasks, and to be able to maintain a level of professionalism, pleasant demeanor, and grounded approach to the work.

**Primary Responsibilities**

***1. Client and Staff Support***

* Greet clients and others who come into the office in a friendly and helpful manner; determine reason for visit, log visitors in and out.
* Provide information and referrals to clients and others as appropriate.
* Notify staff of clients or other’s presence; facilitate communication between clients and staff.
* Accompany clients into Etta’s Closet on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and assist in keeping the closet organized, stocked, and neat.

* Support case managers with organizing and sorting their client files.

* Inform direct supervisor/s when we’re running low on office and/or cleaning supplies, client snacks, and other important materials.
* Assist with welcoming new staff and acclimating them to the office culture.
* Post TGIJP and partner event flyers around the office as directed.

***2. Safety Support***

* Monitor clients entering and exiting the space for weapons, and maintain bike tracking and storage.
* Supervise clients, staff, and the general public who may be waiting in lobby or front desk areas.
* Maintain safety protocol, and serve on the TGIJP Safety Committee.

***3. Administrative Support***

* Organize and manage the front desk, documents, and relevant paperwork while removing any clutter.
* Answer front desk phone calls while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
* Answer and forward general inquiries sent to the inbox.
* Print and update the client and staff front desk sign-in sheets.
* Distribute client mail to clients and Housing Case Managers.
* Promote upcoming TGIJP events and client satisfaction surveys.
* Attend training and meetings as scheduled and assigned.
* Submit monthly progress reports to the Program Director.
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Director.

***4. Cleaning***

* Maintain cleanliness across the building, also including the front door, restrooms, and outside area around the building.
* Restock the waiting room fridge, supply closet, restrooms, and snack trays as needed.
* Refill the water cooler in the waiting room as needed.
* Take out the trash in every room in the office each day, and take out the trash that has collected in the waste bins every Wednesday night at midnight.
* Vacuum, sweep, dust, and mop the office as directed.
* Safely utilize cleaning chemicals.
* Inform leadership when repairs are needed.
* Assist with setup and takedown of TGIJP meetings and events as requested.
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Director.

***5. Driving***

* Drive clients and staff to their meetings and appointments in the TGIJP van as requested, ensuring that all riders comply with the no smoking/vaping requirement.
* Drive clients to receive wellness services in the TGIJP van.
* Be available by call, text, and/or calendar for staff and clients to request transportation.
* Maintain knowledge of the van key’s location at all times.
* Park the van in designated parking spaces only.
* Keep the van clean and stocked with waters and snacks.
* Record rides, mileage, and vehicle servicing history as requested.

**Qualifications:**

***Education:*** Open.

***Experience:*** Open. Active CA driver’s license required to be able to drive the TGIJP van.

***Skills:***

* TGI and systems-impacted cultural competency.
* Harm reduction and trauma-informed mentality.
* Demonstrated prompt, efficient, self-motivated, and reliable work ethic.
* Outstanding interpersonal communication skills.
* Elevated understanding of Google Suite software.
* Grounded, calm mindset during high-intensity moments.
* Attention to detail.
* Can lift items weighing 25-50 pounds.

**Working Conditions:**

This position may require occasional evening or weekend hours to accommodate client needs.

**Benefits:**

TGIJP provides all full-time staff with comprehensive medical, dental, vision, commuter, chiropractic, and acupuncture benefits, along with a generous PTO package.

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and experience to jobs@tgijp.org.

“We’re not in the shipping business; we’re in the information business” -Peter Rose, Expeditors Founder

As a Fortune 500 company, Expeditors employs more than 18,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 300 locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems. Our services include the consolidation and forwarding of air or ocean freight, customs brokerage, vendor consolidation, cargo insurance, time-definite transportation, order management, warehousing, distribution and customized logistics solutions. **About the role and team**  
  
Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You'll need to take ownership, stay adaptable, and build with both urgency and care. If you're energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact - this is where you'll grow.
  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. You'll build high-performing teams in ambiguous environments, make hard calls under pressure, and carry the weight of decisions that matter. In this role, you will be the regional business owner for our largest restaurant segment, navigating the messy reality of scaling growth while building a high-integrity team culture.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Build and inspire a high-performing team of Account Managers, coaching them through tough negotiations and providing real-time feedback to maintain a high talent bar.
* Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities to own the growth strategy for SMB restaurant partners, making data-driven decisions on investment and revenue expansion.
* Manage complex stakeholder dynamics, acting as a trusted advisor to restaurant partners while aligning internal teams across Sales, Ops, and Product to unblock growth.
* Drive merchant revenue and value by aggressively advocating for product adoption and marketing initiatives, even when faced with client objections or pricing pushback.
* Design and audit scalable account management processes, identifying what's slowing the team down and implementing repeatable playbooks to improve retention.
* Own the commercial performance of your region, taking full accountability for business metrics and the long-term sustainability of partner relationships.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience within Account Management or Sales organizations.
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing target-driven commercial teams.
* Strong analytical skills with a track record of using data to drive business decisions.
* Fluency in the required local language and English.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in people management.
* Experience in tech, food delivery, or marketplace businesses.
* Expertise in building and auditing Account Management processes in a rapid-growth environment.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to lead through high levels of ambiguity and organizational change.  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The total on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $205,714 - USD $228,571. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $144,000 per year - USD $160,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $61,714 - USD $68,571.  
  
The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance and its payment is based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan.  
  
An equity award and other forms of compensation may be included in the offer. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Allied Universal® is hiring an Account Manager. As an Account Manager, you are the driving force behind daily security operations, ensuring the safety and well-being of the people and places you protect. You will lead from the front—guiding, developing, and motivating your team of security officers and supervisors to deliver exceptional service. This is your opportunity to lead with purpose, make a real impact, and create a safer environment for those who count on you.

**Why Join Allied Universal?**

* **Career Growth:** Opportunities to advance within a global leader in security services
* **Impactful Work:** Play a vital role in protecting people, property, and businesses
* **Supportive Team:** Work with caring professionals dedicated to safety and excellence

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Manage scheduling:** Leverage AI-powered technology to effectively schedule security officers, meeting client contract hours while minimizing unbilled overtime
* **Lead and Develop Security Teams:** Hire, coach and manage security officers and supervisors while overseeing payroll, performance, and employee relations
* **Enhance Client Relationships:** Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring high-quality service that protects people and property
* **Handle Security Incidents and Emergencies:** Respond to escalated issues professionally, coordinating with clients and internal teams
* **Direct Compliance and Security Operational Excellence:** Oversee training, safety, and site operational standards as well as managing inventory (uniforms, equipment, and other essential supplies)

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Valid driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle while conducting business
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in business operations, security management, or supervising teams in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in leading, developing, and retaining a dynamic team while building positive client relationships
* Knowledge of emergency preparedness, physical security protocols, risk assessments, and law enforcement coordination
* Proven ability to evaluate situations, make sound independent decisions, and resolve conflicts in an efficient manner
* Proficiency in web-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients and employees while managing multiple projects and driving operational excellence
* Financial acumen; able to manage staffing levels while minimizing non-billed overtime and managing turnover costs; planning and organizing skills to control costs related to inventory (uniforms, equipment, etc.)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):**

* College degree in Business Administration or a law enforcement-related field
* Law enforcement, military, and/or contract or proprietary security services, or facility management experience
* American Society of Industrial Security (ASIS), International Certified Protection Professional (CPP) certification
* Previous payroll, billing, or scheduling experience
* Aptitude with security systems: CCTV, access control, and badge administration
* Graduate of certified public safety academy (e.g., Law Enforcement, Firefighter/Paramedic, Corrections Officer)

**BENEFITS:**

* Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, retirement plan and disability insurance
* Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
* Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly; unused vacation is only paid out where required by law

**PAY:**

* $72,000 - $77,000/yr.

**Closing**
-----------

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS is seeking an experienced Strategic Account Manager to lead and continue to expand the business with one of our company’s largest and most innovative customers.  
  
The Strategic Account Manager will be a key member of the team responsible for providing business leadership and creative direction for this highly visible customer. You will build and maintain broad relationships in the account, develop and manage opportunities, and lead a large team of extended resources. You will define the executive relationship strategy within the account; including building a strong working relationship with the AWS senior leadership team for executive sponsorship, executive business reviews, and shaping go-to-market opportunities.  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the 8 description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  
Increase technology adoption and creating long term transformational account strategies  
Build strategic relationships within the account and articulate a clear vision with impact across all business groups  
Identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing large-scale technology projects to global business units  
Work will all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solutions Architects, Business Development, Partners, and Professional Services)  
  
About the team  
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Los Angeles, CA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in sales, digital marketing, or digital advertising through full time roles, internships, or relevant coursework.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently in order to interact in this customer-facing sales role.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time for client meetings and training, as required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience working with Google Ads, managing advertising and media campaigns.
* Ability to work towards strategic goals in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent client service, relationship building, organizational, investigative, problem-solving, and influencing skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Account Manager Associate, you will be part of the Google Americas sales associate program. Through this program, Google develops sales associates in specific product and business training and executive access/exposure over a fixed period of time. You will move across different Google advertising sales teams and roles, serving as media account managers for short-term assignments to help cover team member extended leaves. Upon completion of the program, you will transition into permanent account manager roles or other positions at Google. You will work in a team-focused environment, managing relationships with clients, and work with your manager to find a permanent role post program.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $75000 - $105000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Take responsibility for the account management of clients on sales team.
* Craft and deliver solutions to customers to achieve their business objectives and drive business growth for Google, with some guidance.
* Partner with customers and help drive customer relationships in order to work towards mutual business objectives. Contribute to building, growing, and maintaining customer portfolios to drive high-impact, long-lasting relationships.
* Provide campaign updates, troubleshoot client challenges, and deliver customer training in all Google tools.

**ABOUT PALO ALTO FIT**

Palo Alto Fit, doing business as Palo Alto Fitness Club, is Palo Alto's premier private personal training facility, home to a team of 30+ professional coaches dedicated to delivering exceptional, individualized training, a team that will grow to 50 in the next 12 to 18 months. Our 8,000 square foot appointment-only facility on California Avenue is designed exclusively for high-quality one-on-one coaching, and we are expanding to approximately 12,000 square feet in 2026/27, every square foot of it dedicated to personal training.

Our clients are professionals, families, and individuals from Palo Alto, Stanford, and the surrounding Peninsula who value expertise, privacy, and a highly personalized training experience. They are discerning and accustomed to excellence, and they expect the same from us. We are not a traditional gym. We are a professional training facility built on relationships, consistency, and long-term client success.

For more than 10 years, Palo Alto Fit has served individuals and families in Palo Alto and built a reputation for professionalism, a well-run studio, and exceptional client care, with more than 200 five-star Google reviews to show for it.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is one of the most critical roles in the studio, and it is a hands-on role. The Fitness Coordinator owns every new client's first ninety days with us, and the relationship after that. You conduct our Fitness Assessment yourself: you see how a person moves, you understand their injuries, limitations and goals, and you write the handover that lets our coaching team build the right program from day one. You match them to the right coach, carry them through their first weeks until training is a habit, check in along the way, and work with the coach so the assessment and the program stay one plan. You sell the first package, you make every renewal happen, and you keep every client training. The first-renewal rate and the renewal rate are the measures of your work.

You are not coaching sessions, and you are not waiting for the phone to ring. You are on the floor: assessing a prospective client at ten, closing a renewal at eleven, briefing a coach in between, calling a client who went quiet, and making sure a thirty-coach calendar, soon fifty, is exactly right. The instinct to solve a problem the moment it appears, rather than pass it on, is the whole job.

And you will work with everyone. In one day you may assess a twelve-year-old athlete with a parent beside them, a founder between meetings, a physician from Stanford, a retired engineer coming back from surgery, and a family of four who train together. Each one needs a different conversation and the same standard of care.

The problems are real and they are yours: the client who paid and never started, the standing slot that quietly ran out, the client at five sessions left whose coach has not yet talked to them about renewing, the family sharing one package who want to know exactly how many sessions are left. Each one is solved by someone who reads the situation, picks up the phone, and sees it through.

The bar here is deliberately high. Everyone on this team earned their place, and that is exactly why they are proud to be here.

**SELL: TURN A PROSPECT INTO A NEW CLIENT**

Be the first point of contact for prospective clients by phone, email, and in person, and the person who runs their first visit.

Conduct the **Fitness Assessment**, our 45-minute in-person consultation and intake: health and training history, a movement screen, a baseline body-composition scan, and the goal conversation. This is a consultation, not a training session, and you run it yourself.

**See and understand the client's limitations.** An old knee, a back that sits all day, a shoulder that will not go overhead, a nervous first-timer: you recognize what the body in front of you can and cannot do yet, and you ask the questions that surface what they did not think to mention.

**Explain in plain words what the assessment showed and how we will get them started:** here is why the knee complains, here are the muscles that need to get stronger first, here are the exercises we begin with.

**Guide each new client to the package and membership that fit their goals, and complete enrollment.** A consultative conversation, never a hard sell. The first package is your close.

Match each new client to the right coach, lock their standing weekly slot, and book their first session before they leave.

**Document the handover:** goals, history, limitations, what to protect, what the client wants to feel. A coach who reads your notes trains the client safely from minute one without the client repeating a word.

**KEEP: THE FIRST NINETY DAYS, AND THE RELATIONSHIP AFTER**

Send the welcome and check-in emails on their day, and call any client who has not started or has gone quiet.

Work our client dashboard every shift: who needs a next session, who is slipping, whose rescan is due, whose standing slot has run out, and act on it the same day.

**Be the link between the assessment and the program:** brief the coach before the first session, agree the next step when something changes, and make sure what you saw in the assessment is what the client is training on.

Check in with the client at the set points of their first weeks, and bring what you hear back to the coach.

Keep every client's record current, so a colleague or coach can pick up the relationship from the profile alone.

Reach back out to quiet clients and past prospects with genuine, low-pressure care.

**RENEW: TURN A NEW CLIENT INTO ONE WHO TRAINS WITH US FOR YEARS**

Track every client's remaining sessions and see each renewal coming at five sessions left.

Make sure the coach opens the renewal conversation, remind at three sessions left, and close and process the purchase so nobody's training lapses.

**About Watershed**
-------------------

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

------------

We’re looking for ambitious sales development hires to bring Watershed to more companies. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a climate program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies engaged on climate and excited about working with Watershed. As an early member of our go-to-market organization, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, help us build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline across North America.

This hire must be in our HQ in San Francisco.

**You will:**

* Open doors. Take a data-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing Watershed’s brand in markets we will be entering soon.
* Inspire action. Persuade prospects of the urgency of climate action and help them understand how Watershed can help them build a high-impact program, fast.
* Communicate like an expert. Companies will feel delighted and informed by your interactions, looking to you for both climate and Watershed product expertise.
* Take extreme ownership. Identify and actively address inefficiencies, : we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed
* Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonizing their supply chain.

* You have 1-3 years of experience in sales or sales development and a consistent record of over-achieving your goals.
* You take extreme ownership of our customers’ first impressions of Watershed. Customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.
* You’re flexible, adaptive, and resilient with a history of leaving systems, processes, and content better than you found them.

**Role Location**: This role will be based in our San Francisco HQ with the expectation of being in office 4x/week.

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests.
