**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination & Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Enjoy figuring things out, connecting the pieces, and learning how different parts of the work fit together.

· Communicate clearly, warmly, kindly, and proactively with clients, nurses, healthcare partners, and teammates.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution-focused when circumstances change or something unexpected comes up.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask thoughtful questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward rather than waiting for every next step to be assigned.

· Take pride in becoming knowledgeable, capable, and dependable in their work.

· Bring a positive, helpful attitude and genuinely enjoy contributing to a collaborative team.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

Healthcare experience is valuable, and we place equal importance on judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, adaptability, curiosity, and a genuine sense of responsibility.

**Schedule, Compensation & Benefits**

· Full-time position starting at $33–$35 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

· Flexible scheduling, primarily based in our Hayward office, with some remote work when appropriate.

· Our office is located in Hayward, CA. Please make sure the commute to our office works well for you before applying.

· Health insurance benefits and retirement savings plan.

· Structured training, written SOPs, cross-training, and opportunities to take on greater responsibility as TLC grows.

**Apply**

We would be happy to meet dependable, thoughtful candidates who enjoy helping others and want to grow with TLC. Above all, client care comes first in everything we do.

Pay: $33.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

**About the Company**

The Armenian General Benevolent Union was established in 1906 and is the world’s largest non-profit organization devoted to preserving and promoting the Armenian identity and heritage through educational, cultural, and humanitarian programs. Founded in 1963, Camp Nubar is a six-week sleep-away summer camp located on its 365-acre home in the Catskill Mountains region of New York State. Each summer over 300 campers from all over the world (Canada, Europe, Eurasia, all across America) call Camp Nubar their home away from home. Camp Nubar has state-of-the-art facilities, a varied program, and is proud to offer a rich cultural experience in an environment that rivals the best privately owned summer camps in America. jobs.title: Field Marketing & Campaigns Manager
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.**

**About the Role**
==================

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.
* Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.
* Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.
* Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.
* Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.
* Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.
* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.
* Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.
* Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.
* Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

**Who You Are**
===============

* 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.
* You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.
* You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.
* You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.
* Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built-world industry.
* Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
* 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office & equipment stipend
* Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

Today, Hornblower Group’s global portfolio covers over 10 countries, over 50 U.S. cities and serves more than 20 million guests annually. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, Hornblower Group’s additional corporate offices reside in San Francisco, California; Boston, Massachusetts; Chicago, Illinois; London, United Kingdom; New York, New York; Dublin, Ireland; and across Ontario, Canada. For more information, visit hornblowercorp.com.

jobs.description:
**Center for Latino Adolescent and Family Health at Johns Hopkins School of Nursing**

**Title of Position:** LPN Clinical Research Coordinator

The Center for Latino Adolescent and Family Health’s (CLAFH’s) mission is to eliminate health inequities and promote overall wellbeing among Latino adolescents and their families. While our work is Latino-focused, our research and resources are applicable to initiatives aimed at ending inequities for other groups. CLAFH’s core work focuses on developing, evaluating, and disseminating family-based interventions and nurse-driven models of health care delivery designed to mitigate harmful social determinants of health, eliminate health inequities, increase Latino engagement in health care, and promote life opportunities. For more information about our center, please see our website.

**Description of Duties and Responsibilities**

The **LPN** Clinical Research Coordinator will oversee the day-to-day implementation of CLAFH's community-based behavioral health and prevention programs, with a focus on coordinating field operations, supervising research and program staff, and supporting the delivery of nurse-led and family-centered services. The position will involve direct engagement with adolescents, young adults, and families, primarily in the South Bronx.

The LPN Clinical Research Coordinator will:

* Oversee daily field operations and implementation of community-based health and prevention programs, including home visits, community outreach, screening, prevention education, and referral and linkage to services.
* Coordinate and supervise field-based research and program staff, including community health workers, family coaches, and other personnel involved in program implementation.
* Develop and coordinate staff schedules, field assignments, training activities, and ongoing supervision to ensure timely and effective program delivery.
* Perform clinical duties within the scope of LPN licensure, including health screenings, patient education, documentation, and other nursing services under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Oversee participant recruitment, enrollment, retention, follow-up, and fidelity to evidence-based and community-derived intervention protocols.
* Support nurse-led care coordination, including identifying participant health and social needs, facilitating referrals, and following up with families to support engagement in appropriate services.
* Coordinate with community partners, health care providers, and social service organizations to support program implementation and strengthen referral and linkage processes.
* Monitor program activities, service delivery, and staff performance to ensure adherence to project protocols, quality standards, and funder requirements.
* Work collaboratively with project leadership and evaluation staff to ensure accurate and timely collection, documentation, and reporting of participant and program data.
* Assist with continuous quality improvement activities, identifying implementation challenges and opportunities to strengthen program reach, engagement, and service delivery.
* Ensure adherence to relevant confidentiality, participant protection, ethical, and regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and applicable human subjects research protocols.
* Support preparation for project meetings, staff trainings, site visits, and other program-related activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of CLAFH's community-based research and intervention programs.

**Qualifications for the Position**

* Current, unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in New York State required.
* Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program required.
* Experience in community health, public health, adolescent health, behavioral health, or related service delivery settings preferred.
* Experience coordinating or supervising community-based research or program staff preferred.
* Experience implementing evidence-based interventions, conducting health screenings, and supporting care coordination preferred.
* Familiarity with substance use prevention, mental health services, and health and social service systems preferred.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.
* Bronx residency and familiarity with South Bronx communities preferred.
* Experience working with Latino, Black, and other historically underserved communities preferred.
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, supervisory, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple program activities and coordinate staff in a fast-paced, deadline-focused environment.
* Willingness and ability to work in community-based settings, including participant homes and partner organizations.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings or weekends as needed for community outreach and program activities.
* Strong commitment to addressing health inequities and supporting adolescent and family wellbeing.

**Supervisory Relationships:** Reports to the Principal Investigator and designated CLAFH leadership. Provides operational supervision to assigned field-based research and program staff. Clinical duties are performed under the supervision required by applicable New York State nursing regulations.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Advancement Operations Coordinator

As an educational and cultural nonprofit institution, the Intrepid Museum promotes the awareness and understanding of history, science and service through its collections, exhibitions and programming in order to honor our heroes, educate the public and inspire our youth. Located in New York City on the Hudson River, the Intrepid Museum was founded in 1982 with the acquisition of the legendary aircraft carrier Intrepid, a National Historic Landmark. Welcoming more than one million visitors annually, the Museum also features the space shuttle Enterprise, the world’s fastest jets and a guided-missile submarine.

Reporting to the Manager, Advancement Operations and Corporate Membership, the Coordinator, Advancement Operations supports all activities related to the Museum’s CRM (Tessitura), assists with the corporate membership program, provides administrative support to the Institutional Advancement department, and project manages specific work throughout the year. This role is crucial to maintaining data integrity and supporting the department’s fundraising efforts. Salay: $55,000

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Database Support: Assist in all aspects of Tessitura database management, including data entry, clean-up, and report generation.
* Acknowledgments: Coordinate acknowledgment letters for awarded grants and corporate membership gifts and enewals, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Corporate Membership Support: Assist with corporate member renewals, correspondence, benefit fulfillment and usage tracking, and logistics for corporate member programs, volunteer opportunities, and VIP visits.
* Corporate Prospect Research: Conduct corporate prospect research and prepare profile reports.
* Publications: Support the production of the annual report and the bi-annual newsletter.
* Member Communications: Support the Institutional Advancement team with member communications, including the monthly member newsletter and upcoming event email distributions, using platforms such as WordFly.
* Project Management: Project manage specific departmental initiatives and timelines throughout the year, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and on schedule.
* Event Support: Attend Institutional Advancement and Museum-wide events as necessary to assist the department.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent combination of academic and work experience. 1–2 years of fundraising, development operations, or related administrative experience, preferably at a cultural institution. Experience working with a donor database; Tessitura experience a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and in internet and other research tools. Demonstrated ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects. Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as necessary.

Intrepid realizes that it is rare an applicant meets 100% of the qualifications for a given role. If much of this job description describes you, then we encouraged you to apply.

Integrity, credibility, collaboration and commitment to Intrepid Museum’s mission are essential.

We offer a competitive salary and the opportunity to be a part of a very rewarding time in the Museum’s history!

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
------------------

Hello Patient is hiring a Strategic Account Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of our customer accounts from signature through post-go-live. You will be the primary relationship holder for your accounts, responsible for ensuring customers consistently realize value from Mia, identifying risks early, and helping customers expand how they use HelloPatient over time.

This is a proactive, ownership-driven role. You’ll maintain a clear, up-to-date understanding of how each account is performing, monitor key signals to catch issues before they escalate, and partner closely with internal teams to drive resolution.

Customers should view you as a trusted partner, essentially an extension of their team who understands their business, not just a point of contact for a software vendor.

While you’ll stay involved during the initial implementation to establish the relationship and ensure smooth handoffs and communication, your core responsibility ramps up after go-live to own the customer experience, manage communication and expectations, and be accountable for long-term customer success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own Account Health**

* Track how the agents are performing across your accounts, including containment, transfers, and reschedule, cancel and confirm rates. Dig into anything unusual before the customer notices it.
* Review call logs and transfers to find where the agent falls short, and suggest fixes to the call flow.
* Turn issues into clear tickets for Product and Engineering, follow them through to resolution, and keep customers updated along the way.

### **Manage Customer Relationships**

* Be the day-to-day point of contact for your accounts. Build a trusted advisor relationship so customers see you as part of their team, not just a vendor contact.
* Run regular check-ins and program reviews, and send a clear status recap after each one.
* Support customers through soft launch, go-live and ongoing agent updates, like new locations, providers, voice and script changes.
* Work with Product, Engineering, QA, Sales and Solutions to get customers what they need, and wear whatever hat the day calls for.
* Join onsite visits, whiteboarding sessions and industry events.

### **Drive Performance & Growth**

* Build recurring performance reports and use them to help customers understand the value they're getting from Mia.
* Help build ROI models from customer data and turn them into clear stories for customer leadership.
* Spot expansion opportunities, such as new agents, chatbot, billing, referrals and new locations, and help Sales and Solution Engineers scope them.
* Support order forms, renewals and invoicing follow-up.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must have:**

* 3+ years in account management, customer success or a similar client-facing role.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can read between the lines, build excitement and handle pushback with confidence.
* A strong storyteller who can turn data into a clear story about value.
* Collaborative and works well with cross-functional teams. You're happy to wear multiple hats.
* Strong attention to detail, so nothing falls through the cracks between customers and internal teams.
* Comfortable with data. You can work in spreadsheets, read dashboards and explain what the numbers mean.
* Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity. You know when to solve a problem yourself and when to escalate.
* You love building from the ground up. You're open to change, can pivot quickly and do well in a fast-paced startup.

### **Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare, health tech or working with medical practices.
* You use AI or automation tools every day to work faster.
* Background in practice operations, revenue cycle or patient scheduling.
* Some exposure to SQL, BI tools or call center metrics.

**Compensation**
----------------

**Base salary:** $80K–$110K

**Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing healthtech startup  
  
**About Hello Patient**

Hello Patient is transforming healthcare communication through advanced conversational AI. Our founding team spent 3.5 years scaling Carbon Health's technology during hypergrowth, where we saw firsthand how much clinical time gets wasted on basic communication—great clinicians buried in admin work, patients stuck in phone tag.

Our AI platform proactively engages patients through perfectly timed calls and texts, resolving complex interactions end-to-end—from scheduling to billing to retention. Built with security and compliance at its core, our technology integrates with existing healthcare infrastructure to deliver 24/7 patient engagement.

Backed by Scale and 8VC, we're building the future of healthcare communication, one conversation at a time.

Compensation Range: $80K - $110K

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

* Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.
* Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organization.
* Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.
* Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.
* Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.
* Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.
* Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.
* Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

**About You**
-------------

This role will be a great fit if you:

* Have 10+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.
* Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.
* Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.
* Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.
* Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

**Our benefits**
----------------

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

**Financial & Insurance**

* Competitive Salary: $180,000-$215,000
* Commission & Equity
* 401(k) (9fin pay 3%, employee contributions are uncapped)
* Private Health Insurance, with Dental and Vision
* Paid sick leave
* Disability Insurance (New York)

**Time off**

* 25 vacation days per year
* Local public holiday
* Work abroad for up to 3 months a year
* 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service
* Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

**Training & Culture**

* Professional learning and development budget
* Bi-annual team socials
* Summer and Winter company social events

**Hybrid Policy**

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

**9fin is an equal opportunities employer**

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, GTM Leadership
jobs.description:
**About Agentio**
-----------------

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they’ve been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.’s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the “On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business” category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

**About the Role**

You’ll start out reporting directly to our CEO, working alongside our sales leaders, with broader scope as the team grows. This is a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

Our CEO and sales leaders are out in the market constantly: at conferences, on customer and investor trips, in rooms full of potential clients we want to meet with. The relationships they start there are some of the best pipeline we have. But leaders get busy, and we need to build a more systematic way of providing leverage to our CEO and GTM leadership.

This is different from a traditional SDR seat. You aren’t working a queue of leads. Your work follows our leaders: where they’re going, who they met, and what’s next. That means the work is less structured, moves faster, and needs real judgment. You’ll write in their voice, manage their threads, and represent them to senior buyers.

You’ll work directly with our CEO and GTM leaders, report into a sales leader, and eventually partner with our SDR Manager as the team grows. It’s a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

**What You’ll Do**

* Take over the outbound inboxes and LinkedIn profiles of our CEO and sales leaders, and run outreach on their behalf in their voice
* After events: build the follow-up list, draft personalized outreach, and run sequences quickly so every conversation gets continued
* Before trips: use Sales Navigator and HubSpot to find our target prospects in each city, then book meetings so leaders’ calendars are full when they land
* Build AI-powered workflows for account research, trigger spotting, drafting, and follow-up, and keep improving them
* Manage replies, handoffs, and scheduling so no warm conversation goes cold
* Work with leaders to plan ahead: know their travel and event calendar, and set targets for each one
* Keep HubSpot clean, and report on what’s working and what isn’t

**Key Metrics You’ll Own**

* Meetings booked for leaders ahead of trips and events
* Share of event contacts followed up with, and how quickly
* Reply and positive response rates
* Pipeline sourced and influenced by leadership outreach
* Quality of accounts and contacts reached

**What You Need**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales development, BDR work, or a similar outbound role where you owned outreach and pipeline; or 1-2 years in a sales or trading role at a leading investment bank
* Demonstrated experience using AI to work faster and smarter (we’ll ask you to show us what you’ve built or how you use it day to day)
* Excellent writing: clear, concise, and able to capture someone else’s voice
* Strong judgment and discretion, because you’ll have access to senior leaders’ inboxes and relationships
* Highly organized, with the discipline to keep dozens of threads moving at once
* Strong data literacy: you know which numbers matter and can work with AI to get to the answer
* 4-year degree from a leading university

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Sales Navigator and HubSpot
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup
* Experience selling into brands, agencies, or the ad tech and media ecosystem
* Experience supporting executives or founders, or running outbound on their behalf

**About You**

* You’re AI-native in how you work: you reach for AI first, and you’re not waiting for permission or a playbook
* You’re a builder who would rather create the system than follow one
* You’re comfortable working directly with executives and holding your own
* You’re fast and follow through: when an event ends, you’re already moving
* Nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptiv

**COME JOIN OUR TEAM!**

**OUR TEAM**

Maverick Studios is where creativity meets impact. As the in-house agency for Inspire Brands, we craft award-winning work that spans design, video, photography, print, and beyond. Serving six iconic brands—Arby’s, Buffalo Wild Wings, Baskin-Robbins, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and Sonic—our team is a powerhouse of collaboration and passion. We’re all about delivering best-in-class creativity, innovation, and solutions that resonate across every project.

**OUR CULTURE**

At Inspire Brands, we’re not just dreamers; we’re doers. We thrive on innovation and welcome bold ideas at every level, from the kitchen to the boardroom. Here, taking risks and thinking differently aren’t just encouraged—they’re celebrated. It’s how we started, and it’s how we succeed.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
Do you thrive on organization, coordination, and keeping complex projects moving? As a **Traditional Marketing Project Coordinator** at Maverick Studios, you'll play a critical role in supporting the execution of traditional marketing initiatives across multiple Inspire Brands.

From point-of-purchase materials and menu systems to packaging updates, photo shoots, promotional merchandising, and in-store marketing collateral, you'll help ensure projects are accurately built, tracked, routed, and delivered from intake through final production.

You'll partner closely with Project Managers, Account Managers, Creative teams, Proofreading, Brand Marketing partners, and external vendors to support the successful delivery of marketing assets that appear in restaurants across the country.

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

* **Traditional Marketing Intake Partner:** Review incoming marketing requests (e.g., POP, packaging, menus, photo shoots, merchandising, print collateral, promotions, etc.) for completeness and accuracy before building in Workfront.
* **Workfront Builder:** Set up traditional marketing projects, align timelines, assign tasks, and track deliverables through completion.
* **Production Coordinator:** Support the execution of packaging, menu, POP, and marketing collateral projects by coordinating assets, approvals, specifications, and production requirements.
* **Feedback Router:** Capture and route feedback from Brand Marketing, Client Relations, Creative, Proofreading, and Production partners to ensure revisions are documented and communicated clearly.
* **Asset Tracker:** Maintain project documentation, version control, routing records, and asset libraries within Workfront, SharePoint, and other team systems.
* **Photo Shoot Support Partner:** Assist with planning and coordination activities for photo shoots, including project setup, timelines, asset collection, deliverables tracking, and post-shoot organization.
* **Delivery Manager:** Upload, distribute, and archive final files to approved repositories and distribution channels.
* **Accuracy Advocate:** Ensure all assets, specifications, and supporting documentation are properly labeled, organized, QA'd, approved, and finalized before release.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Experience:** 1-2 years in a marketing, creative operations, project support, production coordination, or agency role (internship or entry-level experience counts).
* **Tool Readiness:** Familiarity with Workfront, Smartsheets, SharePoint, or similar systems, or a strong eagerness to learn quickly.
* **Production Awareness:** Basic understanding of traditional marketing deliverables such as packaging, menus, POP materials, photo shoots, print production, and marketing collateral.
* **Organized Mindset:** A love of lists, timelines, status updates, and keeping projects neat, tidy, and trackable.
* **Communication Skills:** Clear and proactive communicator who can manage updates across multiple stakeholders and project teams.
* **Detail Obsessed:** You catch the small things (file names, version control, specifications, deadlines, and approvals) that keep projects running smoothly.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** A team-first attitude. You're dependable, approachable, and always willing to lend a hand.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

* **People-First Culture:** Join a supportive, collaborative team that values growth and shared wins.
* **Creative Exposure:** Learn the inner workings of a full-service in-house agency and contribute to projects for six iconic brands.
* **Career Growth:** Build foundational project management skills with clear pathways to grow into Project Manager and beyond.
* **Team Spirit:** Expect kudos, brainstorms, and plenty of snacks along the way.
* **Perks & Personality:** Free ice cream, cold brew, and a beer/wine wall fuel the fun.

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 4 years – Bachelor’s Degree
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related fields and/or experience working in a brand marketing role or agency environment

  
Inspire is a multi-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,000 Arby’s, Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide.  
  
We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

* Travel regularly to customer locations, Pratt facilities, trials, business reviews, and industry events.

**What You'll Get**

* Experience the satisfaction of driving company growth with sustainable solutions
* Benefit from a supportive team culture with growth and mentorship opportunities
* Be part of a professional culture operating with integrity and a commitment to safety
* Receive personal and professional benefits tailored to support your life

**Your Role at a Glance**

Success in this role comes from leveraging your:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* Five to ten years of complex B2B, national-account, or enterprise sales experience
* Packaging, corrugated, manufacturing, consumer products, retail, or supply-chain experience preferred
* Demonstrated success managing multimillion-dollar accounts and complex sales cycles
* Experience leading RFPs, pricing negotiations, contracts, and executive business reviews
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including margin and profitability management
* Ability to influence across functions without direct authority
* Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft 365, forecasting, and account-planning tools
* Willingness to travel, with an estimated travel percentage if known

When you bring your commitment to growth and sustainability into our collaborative culture, we unlock endless opportunities for innovation and excellence.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you're prepared to shape the future of sustainable packaging with us, apply now. Align your career with a company that values your contributions and is committed to your professional journey. Embark on a path that unboxes your best life at Pratt Industries.

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 8,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest."

jobs.description:
**Pharmaceutical Sales Representative: Carrollton, GA Territory**

At Galt Pharmaceuticals, we've found a better way to improve patients' quality of life through innovative products that address unmet clinical needs. At the same time, we're creating life-changing opportunities for entrepreneurs, employees, and the communities we serve.

The Pharmaceutical Sales Representative is responsible for developing and managing territory accounts through healthcare provider offices while effectively managing resources and expenses. This role requires a unique blend of sales acumen, business analysis, and entrepreneurial thinking. Successful candidates are naturally curious, solutions-oriented professionals who can identify opportunities, overcome challenges, and build lasting value-based relationships with customers.

**Why Join Galt Pharmaceuticals?**

We're not your traditional pharmaceutical company.

Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and employee-focused. We empower our team members to think creatively, solve complex challenges, and make a meaningful impact every day. At Galt, you'll work alongside driven professionals who are passionate about delivering better outcomes for patients while continuously learning and growing. We value innovation, accountability, and work-life balance, offering flexibility and autonomy that allow our employees to thrive both professionally and personally.

**What We Offer**

This full-time salaried position includes a comprehensive benefits package and an exceptional work-life balance through our 4-day workweek (Monday-Thursday, with Fridays off)!

Benefits include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Life and disability insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Join a collaborative team that values creative problem-solving, entrepreneurial thinking, and a customer-first approach in a fast-paced, solutions-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Business Development**

* Develop and manage the territory as a business profit center.
* Create and execute a territory business plan to achieve sales objectives, including account targeting, marketing initiatives, expense management, and time allocation.
* Build and develop a minimum of 20 accounts that meet established "Galt 20" performance parameters.
* Establish strategic partnerships with healthcare providers, medical practices, and pharmacy partners.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales, to share insights and best practices.

**Territory Management**

* Represent Galt Pharmaceuticals in alignment with the company's Vision and Guiding Principles.
* Develop a strong understanding of the communities and healthcare landscape within the assigned territory.
* Analyze sales, prescription, and market data to identify opportunities, trends, and growth strategies.
* Effectively utilize CRM platforms and business analytics tools to track performance and customer engagement.
* Take a relationship-based approach to territory management, focusing on patient and provider needs rather than competitive targeting.
* Serve as an ambassador for Galt's mission of delivering "A Better Way" to provide pharmaceutical care, one patient at a time.
* Adapt quickly to changes in the marketplace and business environment to drive continued account growth.
* Make fiscally responsible decisions regarding territory expenses and resource allocation.
* Partner with Accounting and Compliance teams when necessary to assist with account documentation and payment collection.
* Execute territory call plans and routing strategies to maximize effectiveness across healthcare offices, pharmacies, physicians, and anchor pharmacy accounts.

**Account Management**

* Execute Galt's Account Management and Sales Processes.
* Partner with customers to identify challenges and implement solutions that create value for their business and patients.
* Differentiate Galt through exceptional concierge-level service and customer support.
* Actively listen to internal and external stakeholders to uncover needs, barriers, and opportunities.
* Leverage strong problem-solving skills and business knowledge to facilitate meaningful customer solutions.

  

**Professional Skills:**

* Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and consultative selling skills.
* Strong active listening, presentation, and interpersonal communication abilities.
* Ability to understand and communicate complex medical and pharmaceutical concepts.
* Proficiency with iPads, computers, mobile technology, and CRM platforms.
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
* Highly self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to balance multiple responsibilities.
* Demonstrated integrity and commitment to high ethical and professional standards.
* 1-2 years of healthcare, DME, B2B, or pharmaceutical sales experience preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Ability to travel approximately 5% for corporate meetings, training programs, and field ride-alongs.

  

**Employment Requirements:**

* Must be able to pass a background check and drug test, consistent with applicable law.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Complete all required online, classroom, and field-training programs within the first two weeks of employment.
* Successfully complete Sales and Clinical/Compliance Training requirements.
* Maintain a valid driver's license and satisfactory driving record.

We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Inside Sales Executive

You will work with sales, marketing, and business partners to support revenue goals, strengthen prospect engagement, and apply the Fiserv Way of Selling throughout the sales process.

**Assistant Project Manager - HVAC**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager - HVAC, you'll support the successful execution of commercial HVAC and integrated mechanical projects by assisting the Project Manager in coordinating activities, ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards, while focusing on HVAC system design, installation, and performance. This role contributes to delivering high-performance, sustainable mechanical outcomes for clients in commercial and critical environments across any of our operating companies. * Assist the Project Manager in planning, coordinating, and overseeing HVAC-related projects, including heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems, ductwork, piping, and integration with building infrastructure.
* Support development and maintenance of project schedules, milestones, and resource allocation using industry-standard tools.
* Track project costs, prepare cost projections, monitor budgets, and assist in identifying and managing variances, change orders, or value engineering opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams (field technicians, engineers, installers, subcontractors), vendors, and clients to ensure timely procurement, submittals, approvals, fabrication, and installation of HVAC equipment and components.

None (this role has no direct supervisory responsibilities but requires close collaboration with project managers, field teams, and other departments; may involve guiding or mentoring junior staff or interns as needed).

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Project, Word); experience with project management software (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360, Bluebeam, or similar) is a plus.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and clients.
* Ability to travel to project sites as required and work in a fast-paced, field-oriented environment.

Modigent is a national leader delivering next-generation infrastructure, technology, and energy solutions through our family of specialized brands in HVAC, plumbing, and controls systems. With a strong coast-to-coast presence and extensive service capabilities, we empower customers, communities, and our over 1,500 team members to thrive with sustainable, efficient commercial building services. As part of our team, you'll contribute to thoughtful innovation and our people-first culture rooted in service, collaboration, and integrity.

**Why Work at Modigent**

------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. **Position Summary:**

The Capacity Building Project Coordinator will provide direct support to the GASC Capacity Building Network for Community Safety, assisting in the implementation of technical assistance, training, and resource development for community-based organizations (CBOs). The Project Coordinator will work closely with the Capacity Building Project Manager to ensure smooth program operations, coordinate service delivery, and track program milestones. This role will be instrumental in supporting CBOs in their organizational development and enhancing their ability to deliver effective community violence intervention programs.

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**

**Program Delivery & Strategic Direction**

* Assist in the execution of capacity-building initiatives, ensuring CBOs receive timely and relevant support.
* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, and technical assistance activities with The Network Training Coordinator and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Serve as a liaison between community partners, technical assistance providers, and program staff.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, including training participation logs and organizational assessments.
* Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of capacity-building efforts.
* Provide direct support to CBOs, connecting them with appropriate resources and funding opportunities.
* Ensure all grant and contract deliverables are met in collaboration with program leadership.
* Assist in the development of toolkits, guidance materials, and best practice documents for community partners.
* Work with internal teams to gather and analyze data for program evaluation and reporting.

  

**Capacity-Building Services & Support**

* Oversee the coordination of workshops, training sessions, and resource-sharing initiatives to strengthen CBOs’ operational and programmatic effectiveness.
* Develop a knowledge management system for best practices, toolkits, and learning materials.
* Provide direct guidance to CBOs on program development, evaluation, and sustainability strategies.
* Ensure ongoing needs assessments are conducted to tailor capacity-building efforts effectively.
* Create and implement individualized capacity building plans with CBOs based off needs assessment data.

  

**Training & Organizational Development Support**

* Assist in the coordination of training sessions for CBO staff.
* Support peer-learning networks and collaborative cohorts within the network.
* Provide technical assistance to CBOs on program planning, data collection, and sustainability strategies through connections with SMEs.
* Research and share emerging best practices in community violence intervention (CVI).

  

**Stakeholder Engagement & Community Partnerships**

* Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including nonprofit organizations, government agencies, funders, and advocacy groups.
* Represent UCAN North Lawndale in meetings, conferences, and advisory boards to promote the initiative’s objectives.
* Advocate for policies and funding mechanisms that support community-based violence intervention and prevention strategies.

  

**Monitoring Service Delivery**

* Assist with the execution of the development department’s strategy to ensure program compliance and each of the Key Program Indicators are met.

**Quality and Accountability**

jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD IPP - MOSAAIC

**About the Department**

The Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH), located in the Biological Sciences Division, integrates a wide spectrum of factors such as human health behaviors, environmental factors, social and economic factors, policies and genetic determinants of health, into studies focused on the treatment and prevention of disease, as well as the maintenance of wellness. Leveraging and integrating the University of Chicago’s considerable institutional strength in population science with research spanning diverse fields such as genetic medicine, cancer epidemiology, microbiome, and epigenomics, the Institute will have the common goal of improving human health outcomes. Another major goal of the Institute will be to develop a new multidisciplinary training program to equip researchers with emerging tools and methods to conduct precision health research within a population health framework. Our faculty lead research projects in biostatistics, epidemiology and health services research and participate in interdisciplinary teams with faculty in other departments to address complex problems in health and healthcare, in our communities and around the globe.

**Job Summary**

The University of Chicago's Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator 2 to support its portfolio of federally funded population health research, with a primary focus on the Multi-ethnic Observational Study in American Asian and Pacific Islander Communities (MOSAAIC) — a landmark NHLBI-funded epidemiological cohort study aimed at addressing critical gaps in cardiovascular, metabolic, pulmonary, and mental health research for Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander communities.  
  
The University of Chicago serves as one of five national clinical and community field centers for MOSAAIC, with a goal of enrolling 2,000 Chicago-area participants through community-based outreach, mobile data collection, clinical phenotyping, and biospecimen collection. The study collects data across a broad range of health domains, including heart health, diabetes, lung health, and mental health, as well as social determinants of health such as environmental exposures and access to care. The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 will support the full research lifecycle across this and related IPPH studies — including participant recruitment and retention, IRB compliance, data and specimen collection, quality control, and milestone reporting — working closely with Scientific Directors and the Research Manager to advance research that promotes health equity and reduces disparities in historically underrepresented populations.  
  
This at-will position is wholly or partially funded by contractual grant funding which is renewed under provisions set by the grantor of the contract. Employment will be contingent upon the continued receipt of these grant funds and satisfactory job performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordination and quality control management for observational and interventional, including both clinic and community-based studies, within the Institute for Population and Precision Health.

* Manage IRB submissions, amendments, and continuing reviews; develop and refine data collection instruments; enforce implementation accuracy and study staff protocol compliance; and deliver continuous milestone reporting — including progress, successes, and emerging challenges — to study leadership.
* Drive participant engagement through active coordination of subject screening, recruitment, informed consent, data and specimen collection, and longitudinal follow-up and retention strategies.
* Monitor study participants, schedule, and conduct study-related procedures (eg. interviews, phlebotomies, and follow-ups) and establish data quality control checks.

B2B Advertising Sales Representative – Upfront & Recurring Commissions

Already Selling to Local Businesses? Add Another Income Stream!

With the holiday season approaching, now is an ideal time to connect with local businesses looking to promote seasonal specials, attract customers, and increase their visibility.

Company: My Zip Ads LLC

Location: Chicagoland, Illinois – Flexible / Local Outside Sales

Compensation: 100% Commission-Based | No Base Salary

Position: Independent Sales Representative opportunity, subject to applicable worker-classification requirements

My Zip Ads is expanding throughout Chicagoland, and we’re looking for motivated, experienced B2B sales professionals who want to earn upfront commissions while building a portfolio of advertisers with long-term recurring income potential.

If you’re already meeting with restaurant owners, contractors, retailers, professional offices, or other local businesses, this could be a natural addition to the services you already offer.

You don’t need to abandon your existing business or start building relationships from scratch. Introduce a valuable advertising opportunity to businesses you already know while continuing to develop your existing sales activities, provided your current agreements permit it.

Whether you’re an established independent sales representative or an experienced salesperson looking for a new opportunity, My Zip Ads offers a flexible way to expand your earning potential.

What Is My Zip Ads?

My Zip Ads is a shared direct-mail advertising program designed to help local businesses reach approximately 10,000 residential households per monthly mailing.

Our oversized 9” × 12” postcards feature multiple local advertisers, allowing businesses to share printing and mailing costs while benefiting from repeated exposure in their communities.

Our advertising program offers:

* Monthly direct-mail advertising
* Category-exclusive advertising opportunities
* Affordable multi-month advertising packages
* Consistent visibility among local households
* Additional printing, graphic design, and marketing services

Our initial target communities include Arlington Heights, Des Plaines, Mount Prospect, Morton Grove, and Niles, with plans to expand into additional Chicagoland markets.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a **Business Development Representative** to join our Intermodal team. In this role you identify new opportunities within the Intermodal service line, and support the selling of creative solutions/services to drive growth through relationship building, problem solving, and providing exceptional service. You will be responsible for delivering customer commitments, resolving issues, driving continuous improvement and articulating customer value. You are responsible for the growth and retention of a customer portfolio or modal offering while also supporting new opportunities. You will use your knowledge of the customer’s business challenges and supply chain goals to develop tailored solutions, which deliver value and support the customer’s business.

This is a hybrid position with 4 days in-office in our Oakbrook Terrace, IL office.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

Strategy & Growth:

* Represents, develops, and enhances the brand
* Penetrates the assigned customer portfolio assigned, by making contacts and building relationships at multiple levels and in multiple departments within the account in partnership with account management, capacity, and/or service line teams.
* Conducts regular business reviews partnering with internal teams (ie, account management, capacity, service lines), leveraging internal analytics and market intelligence to gain customer insights, and understands positive and negative trends in data, to uncover new opportunities for growth, increase sales, and retain and grow the business by presenting solutions to help the customer win.
* Shares customer specific data, requirements and expectations with internal resources in order to collaboratively create viable supply chain solutions for customers
* Reviews of financial, volume and service performance reports and makes adjustments (pricing, process, etc.) that create efficiencies and drive continuous improvement
* Uses effective negotiation and sales strategies in discussing pricing and selling solutions
* Stays informed of changes within the customers’ business, industry and sector through regular customer communication; applies that knowledge to identify new opportunities

Customer Service:

* Serves as the primary point of contact, delivering a positive customer experience through proactive communication, timely responses and by applying the appropriate sense of urgency as the situation dictates

* Manages conflict and navigates difficult conversations, using tact and diplomacy
* Collaborates and actively communicates with partners on the commercial/ account management/ capacity/product/supply team regarding customer needs, issues and solutions in order to meet customer expectations
* Builds trusting relationships by ensuring quality execution against expectations and collaborating with internal partners to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner
* Uses effective negotiation and sales strategies in discussing pricing and selling services.
* Partners with commercial, account management and customers to gather information on inbound & outbound needs, and offers tailored solutions based on the CHR platform in order to build customer relationships and win business
* Stays informed and may respond to customer inquiries and provide updates related to exception management to articulate actions being taken

Execution leading to Quality:

* Monitors order statuses and initiates corrective action when exceptions occur (verifying pricing, weights, delivery times, ship quantities, load information, etc.)
* Understands customer workflows, preferences and SOPs and applies this knowledge to create efficient, cost effective solutions for the customer
* Provides ongoing issue resolution through communication with the customer and offers options and alternative solutions in a timely manner

Process Efficiency:

* Leverages customer facing technology to ensure the right technology is matched to customer needs
* Organizes and prioritizes opportunities utilizing sales management tools such as opportunity management, Atmosphere
* Uses internal tools and resources, including but not limited to service line and pricing SMEs, to determine customer pricing strategy
* Assists in the development of any SOPs required to manage the customers’ business effectively

Pricing:

* Collaborates in pricing strategy through a clear understanding of customer buying habits and CHR’s position within the customer’s supply chain
* Uses internal tools and resources, including but not limited to service line and pricing SMEs, to determine customer pricing strategy
* Collaborates with RFP opportunities for customers within portfolio

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Required:

* High School Diploma or GED
* Minimum 2 years of previous sales experience
* Ability to travel internationally and domestically

Preferred:

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Demonstrated negotiation and sales strategies experience
* Decision making and multi-tasking skills
* Effective and flexible communication and interpersonal skills
* Driven, enthusiastic, resilient, agile and highly motivated
* Ability to thrive under deadlines and drive results,
* Attention to detail and analytical ability
* High comfort level with technology and the ability to quickly learn new systems
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs
* Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Compensation Range**

$32.16 - $50.81

The base pay range displayed on the job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for this specific location. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting

**About Us**  
Join our growing team at American Friends of the Hebrew University (AFHU), a national, not-for-profit organization whose mission is to support the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, one of the world’s most distinguished academic and research institutions. Its students, faculty, and alumni have won 10 Nobel Prizes, developed treatments for diseases, and ignited innovation that has led to more than 12,600 patents.
  
  
**About the Opportunity**  
The Midwest Region Development Assistant will report to the Regional Executive Director and will be an integral part of the Midwest fundraising team, providing support across fundraising, donor management, events, and regional operations.  
  
This is a hybrid position based in AFHU’s Midwest Region office in Chicago, Illinois, with a combination of in-office and remote work. The position will also require occasional evening and weekend availability for donor events and regional programs.  
  
**About You**  
The ideal candidate is a proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented professional who is highly organized, flexible, and comfortable managing multiple priorities. They enjoy working closely with colleagues on a small, growing team in a mission-driven environment and bring professionalism, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to supporting fundraising and donor engagement.  
  
**Position Responsibilities:**  
  
**Fundraising Support**

* Development Operations and Gift Administration:
  + Manage the Midwest Region’s core gift administration and development operations accurately, consistently, and in a timely manner.
  + This includes gift coding and documentation, donor acknowledgements and thank-you letters, tribute correspondence, donor recognition, donation tracking, donor reporting and stewardship materials, and other required gift-processing activities.
* Raiser’s Edge, Donor Interaction Tracking, and Reporting:
  + Strong knowledge of Raiser’s Edge to ensure that the Midwest Region maintains accurate, current, and useful donor and prospect records.
  + This includes maintaining constituent information, recording gifts, stewardship activities, event participation, donor correspondence, and other appropriate actions; and ensuring relevant documentation is attached to constituent records.
* Donor Stewardship and Follow-Through:
  + Provide consistent administrative support for Midwest donor stewardship, including donor acknowledgements, thank-you letters, donor reports, recognition correspondence, donor calls as assigned, stewardship materials, and appropriate follow-up.

**Event and Meeting Support**

* Event, Board Meeting, and Hebrew University Visitor Execution:
  + Serve as the primary administrative and logistical support for Midwest events, donor gatherings, Board meetings, and visits from Hebrew University faculty, content experts, and senior leadership.

**General Administration**

* Executive Director and Regional Administrative Support:
  + Provide reliable administrative support to the Executive Director and Midwest Region, including monthly expense reports, invoices and financial documentation, meeting materials, scheduling and logistical support as appropriate, regional communications, filing and organizational systems, and other administrative responsibilities.
* Special projects as assigned

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of administrative experience; experience in a nonprofit organization preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT or a similar donor/CRM system.
* Strong writing and internet research skills.
* Familiarity with Canva or similar design applications is a plus.
* Accountability, Prioritization, Communication and Follow-Through
* Demonstrate consistent ownership of assigned responsibilities and recurring processes by tracking work through completion, prioritizing appropriately, and meeting agreed-upon timelines.

  
**Salary Range: $60,000–$70,000**  
  
AFHU offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, a 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan, TransitChek Program, Employee Assistance Program, and a generous time-off and holiday policy.

At Nuwave, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions in the wireless telecom industry. Whether it’s streamlining site acquisition or executing complex construction projects, our talented team is at the forefront of the industry. This role is a full-time, in-office position based out of our Signal Hill, CA headquarters.

We're expanding our Southern California PMO and seeking experienced Project Coordinators at the I, II, and III levels to support our Project Management team on wireless deployments across LA, Orange County, Inland Empire, and San Diego areas. Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. With deep expertise in grid modernization and a passion for creating resilient, responsive energy solutions, Critical Loop drives innovation at the intersection of technology and energy.

**The Role**

We are hiring an Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support the deployment and day-to-day operation of our mobile battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

This role will own much of the coordination required to move equipment to and from customer sites, manage rental and transportation vendors, maintain accurate site and asset records, support receiving and warehouse activities, and keep operational and maintenance documentation organized.

This is a hands-on, onsite role that combines logistics coordination, operational administration, and practical field support. You will work closely with our Operations Engineers, Projects, Sales, Accounting, and external vendors to make sure equipment, records, and services are where they need to be when they need to be there.

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, follows through reliably, and is comfortable handling both administrative work and practical onsite tasks.

**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate transportation, delivery, retrieval, and staging of batteries, generators, trailers, and other equipment for customer deployments
* Coordinate with rental companies, trucking providers, fuel vendors, and other service providers
* Track equipment rentals, delivery schedules, vendor commitments, and open logistics items
* Support review and reconciliation of rental invoices, fuel deliveries, and other operational costs
* Maintain accurate site, asset, vendor, rental, and operational records in systems such as Salesforce, Odoo, and other internal tools
* Keep maintenance records, service history, and equipment documentation organized and up to date
* Receive packages, freight, and equipment deliveries at our Long Beach facility
* Support warehouse and material-handling activities, including forklift operation once certified
* Assist with equipment registrations, DMV visits, permits, documentation, and other operational administrative tasks as needed
* Track open issues and follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders until they are resolved
* Support site mobilizations and demobilizations by confirming equipment, transportation, vendor, and delivery requirements
* Help identify discrepancies in records, invoices, deliveries, serial numbers, schedules, or other operational information
* Support Operations Engineers and project teams with ad hoc logistics and administrative needs
* Occasionally travel locally to vendors, customer sites, DMV offices, or other locations as required

**Must-Haves**

* Experience coordinating construction logistics, equipment rentals, fleet, field service, or similar physical operations
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent tasks, vendors, and deadlines
* Comfortable working onsite and performing hands-on tasks including receiving freight, warehouse support, material handling, and local errands
* Clear written and verbal communication with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Basic spreadsheet and data competency, including comfort reviewing invoices, fuel deliveries, rental charges, and operational records

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Familiarity with BESS, generators, electrical equipment, or other industrial power systems
* Experience with Salesforce, Odoo, ERP, CMMS, inventory, fleet-management, or similar systems
